rest:
## GOVINDA

He was a disciple of Śyāmānanda Prabhu and hailed from Sripata Gopiballavpur. (Premavilāsa 20)

fields.name: Govinda (disciple of Śyāmānanda)
fields.notes:
A disciple of Śyāmānanda Prabhu, of the Śrīpāṭa of Gopīballabhpur: «Uddhava, Akrūra, Madhusūdana, Govinda» (Prema-vilāsa 20; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

This record («Govinda») mixed many persons of the same name; on 05-11-2026 they were separated into their own records: Govinda the servant of Lord Caitanya, Govinda (Puṇḍarīkākṣa), Govinda dāsa Kavirāja (the poet), Govinda Kavirāja of Nityānanda's branch, Govinda Ācārya, Govindānanda Purī, Govinda the disciple of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya, Govinda the disciple of Rasikānanda, Govinda Dāsa of Ghāṭaśilā, Govinda dāsa Bābājī of Purī (d. 1930), and the Govinda of Vṛndāvana (in «Govinda Bhakata»).

Kāyastha (he called himself a śūdra). Disciple of Īśvara Purī, who before leaving this world sent him and Kāśīśvara to serve Lord Caitanya; the Lord's dear servant and door-keeper in Purī to the end (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Madhya 10.131-148, Antya 10.83-99). Branch of Lord Caitanya (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).
A close associate of Lord Caitanya. In his past incarnation the Vaikuṇṭha-pārṣada Puṇḍarīkākṣa (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 116). The Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna counts him apart from Govinda the servant.

fields.aka: Govinda dāsa, Dāsa Govinda, Govinda Kavirāja, Kavīndra, Govinda Dāsa Ṭhākura
fields.place: Tiliyā-Budhuri (Murshidabad); born at his maternal grandfather's house
fields.works: Saṅgīta-mādhava-nāṭaka; Śrī Rāma-carita-gīta; Gītāvalī; about 430 padas in Brajabuli (Padakalpataru), 79 gītas in the Kṣaṇadā-gīta-cintāmaṇi
fields.notes:
Vaidya. Younger brother of Rāmacandra Kavirāja; father Ciranjīva Sena, mother Sunandā; maternal grandfather Dāmodara Kavirāja, a Śākta, who brought him up. Wife: Mahāmāyā Devī; son: Divya Siṁha (then Ghanaśyāma, Svarūpanātha, Haridāsa). A Śākta in his youth, he took dīkṣā from Śrīnivāsa Ācārya when he was gravely ill. Jīva Gosvāmī and the Vaiṣṇavas of Vṛndāvana gave him the title «Kavirāja» (Kavīndra) (Bhakti-ratnākara 9.176). The foremost poet of Brajabuli; one of the eight Kavirājas.

The padāvalī «Govinda dāsa Ṭhākura» (62 rāgas, translated by Kuśakratha dāsa) came here from the record «Govinda» (05-11-2026).
Of the branch of Nityānanda Prabhu: «Govinda, Śrīraṅga, Mukunda — three Kavirājas» (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.51; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

A resident of Vṛndāvana, Govinda was a devotee of Lord Caitanya. Govinda accompanied Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī and other devotees to see the Deity Gopāla in the temple of Vithalesvara in Mathurā. (CC. 2.18.52)

A Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava of Vṛndāvana, disciple of Kāśīśvara Gosvāmī; he served the Deity of Śrī Śrī Govindadeva, and with the Vaiṣṇavas of Vṛndāvana went to welcome Vīrabhadra Gosvāmī (Bhakti-ratnākara 6.513, 13.324-325). When Śrīnivāsa Ācārya left for Gauḍa with the books, he blessed him (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). (This came from the record «Govinda», 05-11-2026.)

A disciple of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya: «Then the Lord showed mercy to one named Śrī Govinda; as soon as he spoke of Śrī Gaurāṅga, prema overflowed» (Karṇānanda 1; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). Perhaps Govinda dāsa Kavirāja, perhaps another.

A disciple of Rasikānanda Prabhu (Rasika-maṅgala, Paścima 14.108). The Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna names two Govindas, disciples of Rasikānanda (Paścima 14.108 and 14.150); see also Govinda Dāsa of Ghāṭaśilā (14.116-117).
A resident of Ghāṭaśilā, disciple of Rasikānanda Prabhu (Rasika-maṅgala, Paścima 14.116-117).

records.name: Govinda dāsa Bābājī (Haridāsa Ṭhākura Maṭha, Purī)

fields.aka: Gauracaraṇa Cakravartī, Govinda Dāsa Bābājī Mahārāja
fields.guru: Rādhāramaṇa Caraṇa Dāsa Deva (dīkṣā); the Kartā Bābājī of Nārāyaṇa-chātā (veśa)
fields.place: Born near Dulalbazar (Noakhali, Bangladesh); Purī, the samādhi maṭha of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; Navadvīpa
fields.notes: Born Gauracaraṇa Cakravartī; an orphan, brought up by the Vaiṣṇavas of Dulalbazar. Initiated in Purī by Rādhāramaṇa Caraṇa Dāsa Deva; bābājī veśa from the Kartā Bābājī of Nārāyaṇa-chātā, with the name Govinda Dāsa. By his guru's order he did jhāḍu-sevā at Rādhākuṇḍa for six years; after his guru's passing he served for twenty-two years the samādhi maṭha of Haridāsa Ṭhākura in Purī, which was about to be sold. He died at Navadvīpa in 1930.

The Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna has three entries «Govinda Ācārya»: (1) of the sub-branch of Gadādhara Paṇḍita, a resident of Malladeśa: «I bow to Govinda Ācārya, full of the nectar of love for Kṛṣṇa, who relishes the joy of Govinda, resident of Malladeśa» (Śākhā-nirṇayāmṛta 50); (2) a learned musician named in the Vaiṣṇava-vandanā and the Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā: «I bow to Govinda Ācārya, full of all virtues, who made the wonderful dhāmālī songs of Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa»; his songs are mixed with those of the two poets named Govinda Dāsa, and it is hard to tell which are his; (3) the author of the Govinda-bhāgavata. Perhaps one person, perhaps more. (From the record «Govinda», 05-11-2026.)

A sannyāsī associate of Lord Caitanya, Prāpti-siddhi among the eight siddhis (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 96-97). According to B. B. Majumdar he was also known as Govindānanda Purī (Vaiṣṇava-vandanā). (From the record «Govinda», 05-11-2026.)
